Exercise A

Ana and Tom

Read the text, then choose the correct word for each gap.

Before you read — optional, not marked
One or two sentences are enough.
Read and complete

Ana and her brother Tom live in Lisbon. She is a nurse, and he is a student. works at a hospital near their flat, and studies music at the university.

Last Saturday was their grandmother's birthday. Ana and Tom bought a blue scarf. gave it to her at lunch, and she loved . After lunch, the whole family sat in the garden, and Tom took photo of everyone.

Exercise D

Introduce two people

A friend is visiting your home for the first time and asks about the people in your life. Write a message of 6–8 sentences (about 60 words) to introduce two people you know. Say who they are, what they do, and something that belongs to them. Use he, she or they, at least one object pronoun (him, her, them) and at least one possessive (his, her, their, hers…).

Useful phrases
You can use these: This is my … . She works as … I see him every … Their house is near … The red bike is hers.
